BREAKpoint

Released February 3, 2016 · 126 cards

Expanded

BREAKpoint is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the XY series, released in English on February 3, 2016. Its main set has 122 cards, plus 4 secret rares numbered beyond the set (126 in total). It includes 104 Pokémon, 21 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

42 illustrators worked on BREAKpoint. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (15), Eske Yoshinob (8), Kagemaru Himeno (6), Ryo Ueda (6), Toyste Beach (6), Shin Nagasawa (5), kirisAki (4), Kouki Saitou (4).
